text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout started: runtime v2.3.1 -> runtime-prod-eu-1. Canary group 1 deployed @ 12:00 UTC, auto-canary checks running. tagging for any pin/hold requests.

marta.sre: seeing increased L2 warnings in canary logs, small GC bump but tail latency still within SLOs. I want to hold before step 2 until we confirm KV-cache warmup profile.

alex.eng-release: noted. Metrics dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/runtime-canary?orgId=1 :eye:. Can we get a short statuspage snippet ready in case we need a controlled maintenance blip?

jon.support: customer comms standby. If we need to pin EU to v2.3.0 temporarily, we should prepare a short status page and email. Most affected customers are Dedicated EU tenants.

nina.product: recommend pin for EU if any sign of increased error rate >0.2% for more than 5m. Otherwise proceed with step 2 after warmup. Agree to draft comms.

marta.sre: confirm: hold at step 1 until kv-cache hit-rate > 85% OR no errors for 10m. If not met by 12:20 UTC, we pin EU and rollback to v2.3.0. I'll toggle canary hold.

deploy-bot: Canary paused (hold tag applied by marta.sre). Step 2 blocked. Rollback/pin window open until 12:20 UTC.

ops-bot: automated snapshot for runtime-prod-eu-1 created (snap-20241105-1207).

jon.support: drafting statuspage snippet now. Suggest ultra-brief: "Investigating elevated latencies for EU runtime following a routine rollout. We may temporarily pin EU region to a previous runtime while we investigate. Impact: possible brief degradation for a subset of requests. ETA: 30 minutes." Will post if pin executed.

alex.eng-release: please include timestamp and the canary id in the post. Also include link for customers to subscribe.

jon.support: statuspage snippet (preview):
```
Components: Runtime - EU region
Status: Degraded (under investigation)
Details: We detected increased tail latency for a subset of requests after a routine runtime upgrade. We may temporarily revert EU to the previous runtime to mitigate. Engineering is investigating; updates every 15 minutes.
ETA: ~30 minutes
```

jon.support: email template draft for Dedicated customers:
```
Subject: Brief service update - EU runtime maintenance

Hi <CustomerName>,

We are investigating increased latencies affecting a subset of requests in the EU region after a routine runtime update. As a precaution, we may temporarily revert EU to the previous runtime to reduce impact.

What to expect:
- Potential short interruptions or degraded response times for requests routed to EU endpoints.
- No data loss expected.
- We will provide status updates and an estimated resolution time within 30 minutes.

If you have any critical runs right now, reply to this thread and we can route traffic to Dedicated backup region for you.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support
```

marta.sre: logs look stable now, kv-cache hit-rate hitting 88% for the canary pods, errors at 0.05% over 10m. Recommend resume rollout and proceed to step 2. I'll lift the hold in 1 minute and monitor closely.

deploy-bot: Hold removed by marta.sre. Proceeding to step 2 -> 4 pods in EU. Canary checks will run for 10m after step completion.

nina.product: confirm we do not need to pin. No customer emails pre-sent. Jon, please keep the statuspage draft in case we need it within the next hour.

jon.support: will keep drafts paused. I'll queue a targeted customer email only if pin happens.

ops-bot: rolling deploy step 2 complete, 4 pods updated. Next health check window until 12:36 UTC.

marta.sre: monitoring P95/P99. If we see >0.3% error rate or sustained P99 > 600ms, enact emergency pin to v2.3.0 and trigger customer message.

alex.eng-release: noted. I'll update release notes to mark this as "staged rollout with short KV warmup observed in EU; mitigation plan: automated pin to v2.3.0 if metrics regress."

nina.product: add a line in release notes about minor GC tuning included in v2.3.1 and potential transient warmup behavior for small request volumes.

jon.support: marking this thread for follow-up. If anything changes, ping @here in #support and I'll escalate to exec-ops if customers are impacted. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Thread closed (canary moving forward). Final status: rollout step 2 completed; monitoring.
